AWAKEN · The Wild Lands · stage 1a · style sheet for approval · 28 October 2026

The wild's own plants

These are the sprites I'm about to put in the game, before any of them goes into a world. Each is 16×16 in Minecraft's own manner. The blades are grey and take the biome's colour the way the game's grass does, so you see each plant here in plains, forest and savanna colour. Seed heads, flowers, berries, canes and frost keep their own colours. Every plant has two to four versions, picked per block, so a field never repeats.

What I need from you: "approved", or what to change (a plant, a colour, a shape). Nothing goes into the world until you answer.

In the world

Mock-ups drawn with the Soft Land plan's block renderer and these exact sprites. The animals are plain box stand-ins. In the game everything sways in the one wind.

The look rules

  • 16×16, nothing bigger (the Soft Land's line).
  • Blades grey and tinted by the biome and the lawn drift; flowers, heads, berries, canes and frost keep their own colour. The two layers sit on the same planes, the way the game draws a grass block's side.
  • Everything that grows sways in the trees' wind and parts round your feet. Fungus, sheds and the ground blocks stay still.
  • Rye bends from its middle: its foot stands still, so three blocks of it never shear apart.
  • Only bramble slows you.
